parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Total number of monthly planning periods

parameters.name: initial_workforce
parameters.description: Initial workforce at the start of period 1

parameters.name: initial_inventory
parameters.description: Initial inventory at the start of period 1

parameters.name: initial_backorders
parameters.description: Initial backorders at the start of period 1

parameters.name: inhouse_material_cost
parameters.description: Unit raw material cost for in-house production

parameters.name: outsourcing_cost
parameters.description: Unit outsourcing cost for finished outsourced units

parameters.name: inventory_holding_cost
parameters.description: Inventory holding cost per unit of ending inventory per period

parameters.name: backorder_penalty_cost
parameters.description: Backorder penalty cost per unit of ending backorders per period

parameters.name: labor_hours_per_inhouse_unit
parameters.description: Labor hours required per unit of in-house production

parameters.name: regular_hours_per_worker
parameters.description: Regular hours supplied by one worker per period

parameters.name: max_overtime_hours_per_worker
parameters.description: Maximum overtime hours allowed per worker per period

parameters.name: minimum_ending_inventory
parameters.description: Minimum required ending inventory at period T

variables.name: inhouse_production
variables.description: In-house production quantity in each period

variables.name: outsourced_quantity
variables.description: Outsourced finished quantity in each period

variables.name: workforce_level
variables.description: Workforce level from period 0 through period T

variables.name: hired_workers
variables.description: Number of workers hired in each period

variables.name: fired_workers
variables.description: Number of workers fired in each period

variables.name: overtime_hours
variables.description: Overtime hours used in each period

variables.name: inventory_level
variables.description: Ending inventory from period 0 through period T

variables.name: backorders_level
variables.description: Ending backorders from period 0 through period T

constraints.name: nonnegative_demand
constraints.description: Demand in each period must be nonnegative.

constraints.name: nonnegative_initial_conditions
constraints.description: Initial workforce, initial inventory, and initial backorders must be nonnegative.

constraints.name: nonnegative_production_and_flow_variables
constraints.description: In-house production, outsourced quantity, overtime hours, inventory, and backorders must be nonnegative.

constraints.name: integer_workforce_variables
constraints.description: Workforce level, hired workers, and fired workers are integer-valued nonnegative counts.

constraints.name: overtime_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Overtime hours are limited by the current workforce and the per-worker overtime allowance.

constraints.name: ending_inventory_requirement
constraints.description: Ending inventory at the horizon must meet the minimum required level.

constraints.name: ending_backorders_requirement
constraints.description: Ending backorders at the horizon must be zero.

constraints.name: workforce_evolution
constraints.description: Workforce evolves across periods through hiring and firing from the previous period.

constraints.name: inventory_backorder_flow
constraints.description: Inventory and backorders evolve period to period based on fulfillment of demand using starting inventory, in-house production, and outsourced units.
constraints.formula: I_t - B_t = I_{t-1} - B_{t-1} + x_t + u_t - d_t

constraints.name: labor_capacity_and_production_link
constraints.description: Regular labor capacity is determined by workforce and regular hours per worker, and in-house production requires labor hours.

constraints.name: inventory_backorder_balance
constraints.description: Inventory and backorders are updated each period by the net supply available after satisfying prior backorders and current demand. The fulfilled demand in period t is represented implicitly by the change in backorders.
constraints.formula: I_t - B_t = I_{t-1} - B_{t-1} + x_t + u_t - d_t

constraints.name: workforce_balance
constraints.description: Workforce evolves from the previous period through hiring and firing.

constraints.name: regular_capacity
constraints.description: Regular production labor hours available in each period are limited by workforce and regular hours per worker, and in-house production must fit within regular hours plus overtime hours.

constraints.name: overtime_worker_cap
constraints.description: Total overtime hours in a period cannot exceed the per-worker overtime cap times the workforce employed in that period.

constraints.name: ending_inventory_minimum
constraints.description: The ending inventory at period T must meet or exceed the minimum required inventory.

constraints.name: ending_backorders_zero
constraints.description: The ending backorders at period T must be zero.

constraints.name: workforce_initial_condition
constraints.description: The workforce state at period 0 is fixed to the given initial workforce.

constraints.name: inventory_initial_condition
constraints.description: The inventory state at period 0 is fixed to the given initial inventory.

constraints.name: backorders_initial_condition
constraints.description: The backorders state at period 0 is fixed to the given initial backorders.

objectives.name: net_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total net profit over the planning horizon, including sales revenue minus material, outsourcing, inventory holding, backorder, regular wage, overtime wage, hiring, and firing costs.

final_objective.description: Maximize total net profit over the planning horizon as a single linear objective, with revenue from fulfilled demand and costs for materials, outsourcing, inventory holding, backorders, regular labor, overtime, hiring, and firing.
final_objective.formula: \Pi = \sum_{t=1}^{T} \left(r\,(d_t + B_{t-1} - B_t) - c^{\mathrm{mat}} x_t - c^{\mathrm{out}} u_t - h I_t - b B_t - w^{\mathrm{reg}} H^{\mathrm{reg}} W_t - w^{\mathrm{ot}} o_t - c^{\mathrm{hire}} H_t - c^{\mathrm{fire}} F_t\right)
